> action modifier card... it has a man on it... it's called, "Change of
> Target"...

Uhm.. change of target cancels the current action, there for modifing
effects to the action are not carried over to the next action you
call.

Form of mist (and shadow body, elder impersonation etc) allow you to
CONTINUE the same action as if unblocked, therefor the modifying
effects stay there.

With the aching beauty change of target works offcourse, if you get
blocked bleeding, change of target and then do a political action, get
blocked chage of target and whatever... but that's not the same as
say, bleed get blocked (have opponent pay for the aching
beauty(beauties)), form of mist superior, get blocked again (opponent
pays again) etc.
